dog.description_text: Meet McFlurry! McFlurry is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XxNmaEVdMfh0vkacVM0LkjRck4PSQ1be/view?usp=drive_link His foster says he immediately settled in, "he’s been incredibly affectionate from the start.... Outgoing, friendly, cuddly, and likes attention, very friendly - wants to hang out and sit on your lap. McFlurry needed a few hours to adjust, but by the evening he arrived, he was so cuddly and friendly! He came up onto my bed and my sister’s air mattress for pets, snuggling next to us and purring. As of recently, he’s taken interest in some of the toys I got him. He really enjoys this little ball with a bell in it! I love how friendly he is. Such a cuddler and so silly and his habit of following me everywhere! He's so incredibly affectionate and loves to be near you."
